hook: Dhoni's gone. Chennai's squad has 4 of 7 roles at playoff level. Only RCB has more.
lines: We graded all ten squads, role by role, against what playoff sides look like. Green is playoff level, amber is close, red is behind.
Chennai's openers, Samson and Gaikwad, are playoff level. Their finishers, five to seven, are behind.
And it's not just Chennai: 6 of 10 squads are behind at five to seven.
